DebiaDRAFT-04514 might be a bifunctional enzyme with dehydrogenase and reductase activities.

DebiaDRAFT 04514 is an acetone-inducible, bifunctional, NADH-dependent dehydrogenase and reductase with a preference for short-chain aldehydes, which is able to oxidize and reduce 3-hydroxibutanal to acetoacetic acid.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we cloned and expressed the gene for the first time and characterized the enzyme in detail for the first time, including its substrate and cofactor specificity.
the enzyme might play a crucial role in acetone activation by D. biacus, for example as bifunctional 1,3-dihydroxybutanal (1,3-BDOH) dehydrogenase/1,3-BD reductase.
the enzyme might be used for biotechnological production of 1,3-propanediol, 1,3-butane-diol, 3-hydro-xybutyraldehyde, and acetoacetate.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the enzyme might be used as a biocatalyst for the production of chiral 1,3-propanediol and 1,3-butane-diol.
the recombinant production of the MDR enzyme may represent an important next step in elucidating the complete degradation pathway of acetone by D. biacus.
acetone can be activated by D. biacus by the use of CO as a cosublstrate.
